facts.fact: Daniel 穿着绿色亨利领衫和深蓝牛仔裤出现在 Lucy 的公寓里；Lucy 把他形容为「休闲版的堕落天使」
facts.anchor: Three: Daniel is here (which I expected), wearing a green henley and dark blue jeans (which I did not).

facts.fact: Daniel 提醒她：他自己说过在做婚宴伴手礼，也说过想观察她就必须动手帮忙
facts.anchor: “You said you were making party favors,” he reminds me. “You also said that if I wanted to observe you, I had to help.”

facts.fact: Daniel 说到 glitter（闪粉）时的语气，像别人在说溃烂流脓的伤口
facts.anchor: He says glitter the way other people might say festering wound.

facts.fact: Lucy 坚称那双闪亮靴子不荒唐，是她在 Gulch 打折时买的
facts.anchor: “Those boots are not ridiculous,” I insist. “I got them in the Gulch on sale. But yes.”

facts.fact: 他趁她外出时送来半打小纸盒，整齐码在茶几上
facts.anchor: Still trying to look stern, he points to a half dozen small cardboard boxes neatly stacked on the coffee table. “Those came while you were out.”

facts.fact: Lucy 被猫绊倒后把整锅番茄酱打翻在地，溅到台面、她身上、猫和从回收站买来的手工材料上
facts.anchor: Me, knocking the entire pot of tomato sauce off the stove and onto the floor, and in the process splattering it all over the counters, me, Wilf, and all the craft supplies I got from the recycling center.

facts.fact: Daniel 身上唯独没有溅到一点番茄酱
facts.anchor: Daniel, oddly, doesn’t have a spot on him.

facts.fact: Jess 提前到访，一手拿白葡萄酒，一手拿自己做的香蕉布丁
facts.anchor: Slowly, I turn to face her. Sure enough, there’s my sister, a bottle of white wine in one hand and what looks like her homemade banana pudding in the other.
